title: SF security deposit interest
rule: San Francisco landlords must pay tenants simple (not compounded) interest on security deposits each year, at the rate the Rent Board sets for each March 1 to February 28 period. The rate is based on the prior calendar year average of the 90-day AA financial commercial paper rate. Example from the Rent Board: a $1,000 deposit at 5.0% earns $50.00.

params.rate_applied: rate in effect on the date each annual payment came due (tenancy anniversary)

notes: Rates before March 2024 were not verified today and are left out; the engine reports those years as needing confirmation instead of guessing. Which period rate applies to a payment, and the exemption list, are not verified.
